symptom: PC cannot reach another device in the same VLAN
topology_note: PC1 connected to SW1 access port intended for VLAN 10.
show_output:
show vlan brief
VLAN 10: Fa0/2
VLAN 20: Fa0/1
PC1 is connected to Fa0/1.
expected_fault: PC1 access port is assigned to the wrong VLAN.

symptom: PC in VLAN 20 cannot communicate with VLAN 30
topology_note: Two VLANs exist on the switch and require inter-VLAN communication.
show_output:
show interfaces trunk
VLANs allowed on trunk: 10,20
VLAN 30 is missing.
expected_fault: VLAN 30 is not allowed across the trunk.

symptom: New VLAN users have no connectivity
topology_note: Access switch should contain VLAN 40 for newly connected users.
show_output:
show vlan brief
10 active
20 active
30 active
40 not present.
expected_fault: Required VLAN 40 is missing from the switch.

symptom: Inter-switch communication fails for one VLAN
topology_note: SW1 and SW2 are connected through a trunk.
show_output:
show interfaces trunk
Trunk: Gi0/1
Allowed VLANs: 10,20
Native VLAN: 99
Required VLAN: 30.
expected_fault: VLAN 30 is not permitted on the trunk.

symptom: PC receives connectivity only after moving to another port
topology_note: PC should use VLAN 20 on SW1.
show_output:
show interfaces switchport
Fa0/5: access VLAN 10
Fa0/6: access VLAN 20
PC is connected to Fa0/5.
expected_fault: PC is connected to a port configured for the wrong VLAN.

symptom: PC can communicate locally but cannot reach remote network
topology_note: PC is connected to R1 and uses a configured default gateway.
show_output:
show ip interface brief
G0/0: 192.168.10.1 up/up
PC gateway: 192.168.20.1
expected_fault: PC has an incorrect default gateway.

symptom: Multiple PCs cannot access networks outside their subnet
topology_note: Users are in subnet 192.168.10.0/24.
expected_fault: Gateway is outside the PC's local subnet.

symptom: PC can ping another local host but not the router
topology_note: PC and router interface should share the same subnet.
expected_fault: Configured gateway does not match the router interface subnet.

symptom: One workstation cannot reach the internet while others can
topology_note: All workstations use the same access network.
show_output:
PC gateway: 192.168.1.254
Other PCs gateway: 192.168.1.1
Router LAN: 192.168.1.1/24
expected_fault: The affected workstation has a wrong gateway.

symptom: PC does not receive an IP address automatically
topology_note: PC is connected to a subnet served by DHCP.
show_output:
show ip dhcp binding
Bindings: none
show ip dhcp pool
Pool available addresses: 0
expected_fault: DHCP pool has no available addresses.

symptom: PC receives an APIPA address
topology_note: PC should obtain an address from the network DHCP server.
show_output:
PC address: 169.254.12.20
show ip dhcp binding
No binding for PC.
expected_fault: DHCP service is not providing an address.

symptom: Only some clients receive DHCP addresses
topology_note: Subnet contains several active clients.
show_output:
show ip dhcp pool
Addresses in use: 98
Maximum addresses: 100
Available: 2
expected_fault: DHCP address pool is nearly exhausted.

symptom: DHCP clients receive an address but cannot reach the gateway
topology_note: DHCP server provides IP, mask and gateway information.
expected_fault: DHCP pool provides an incorrect default gateway.

symptom: Users can ping an IP address but cannot open a website by name
topology_note: Clients have normal IP connectivity to the network.
show_output:
ping 8.8.8.8: success
nslookup example.com: DNS server timeout
expected_fault: DNS resolution is failing.

symptom: DNS lookup returns an incorrect server address
topology_note: Clients rely on the configured DNS server.
show_output:
nslookup internal.example
Server: 192.168.1.53
Response: NXDOMAIN
Configured DNS server should be 192.168.1.10.
expected_fault: Clients are using the wrong DNS server.

symptom: Only internal names fail to resolve
topology_note: Internet connectivity is working but internal hostnames are unavailable.
show_output:
nslookup fileserver.corp
Server: 192.168.1.10
Response: SERVFAIL
expected_fault: Internal DNS service or DNS zone is failing.

symptom: Router cannot reach a remote subnet
topology_note: R1 should communicate with network 10.20.0.0/24 through R2.
show_output:
show ip route
10.20.0.0/24 route not present
Connected: 10.10.0.0/24
expected_fault: R1 is missing a route to the remote subnet.

symptom: One remote network is unreachable but other networks work
topology_note: R1 has several static routes.
expected_fault: Route to 10.40.0.0/24 is missing.

symptom: OSPF neighbors are not forming
topology_note: R1 and R2 should establish an OSPF adjacency.
show_output:
show ip ospf neighbor
No neighbors
show ip interface brief
G0/1 up/up
R1 OSPF area: 0
R2 OSPF area: 1
expected_fault: The routers are configured for different OSPF areas on the shared link.

symptom: Traffic takes an unexpected path
topology_note: Two routers advertise the same destination.
show_output:
show ip route 10.50.0.0
Static route: 10.50.0.0/24 via 10.0.0.2
OSPF route also available via 10.0.0.3
expected_fault: A conflicting static route is influencing path selection.

symptom: Router interface is up but connected network is missing from routing table
topology_note: R1 interface should provide access to 192.168.100.0/24.
show_output:
show ip interface brief
G0/2: 192.168.100.1 up/up
show ip route
192.168.100.0/24 not shown
expected_fault: The interface configuration/routing state is inconsistent and the connected network is not being installed.

symptom: Users can reach the gateway but cannot reach a protected server
topology_note: Client VLAN should access a server VLAN through a router.
show_output:
show access-lists
Extended ACL 101
10.10.10.0/24 -> 10.20.20.10 DENY
Implicit deny present.
expected_fault: ACL is blocking client traffic to the server.

symptom: Only HTTP traffic is blocked while ping works
topology_note: Web server should be reachable from the client network.
show_output:
show access-lists
DENY tcp any host 10.20.20.10 eq 80
ICMP permitted.
expected_fault: ACL explicitly denies HTTP traffic.

symptom: Guest users cannot access the internet
topology_note: Guest VLAN traffic passes through an edge router.
show_output:
show access-lists
Guest subnet 192.168.50.0/24 denied by outbound ACL.
expected_fault: Outbound ACL blocks guest traffic.

symptom: Internal PC cannot access the internet
topology_note: Inside network uses private RFC1918 addresses and should be translated.
show_output:
show ip nat translations
No translations
show running-config
No NAT rule for 192.168.10.0/24
expected_fault: Required NAT configuration is missing.

symptom: Some users can access the internet but others cannot
topology_note: Two internal subnets share the same router.
show_output:
show ip nat translations
192.168.10.20 translated
192.168.20.20 not translated
NAT ACL matches only 192.168.10.0/24
expected_fault: NAT rule does not include the second internal subnet.

symptom: Port forwarding to an internal web server fails
topology_note: External clients should reach an internal server on TCP port 80.
show_output:
show ip nat translations
No static mapping for TCP 80
Internal server: 10.0.0.10:80
expected_fault: Required static NAT/port-forwarding rule is missing.

symptom: Wireless clients connect to the AP but cannot reach the network
topology_note: AP is connected to a switch and clients should join the wireless VLAN.
show_output:
show vlan brief
VLAN 30 active
AP switch port assigned to VLAN 10
Wireless clients use VLAN 30.
expected_fault: AP switch port is mapped to the wrong VLAN.

symptom: Wireless clients repeatedly disconnect
topology_note: Several clients connect to the same access point.
show_output:
show wlan summary
SSID: CampusWiFi
Security: WPA2
Client authentication failures: repeated
Configured key differs from client key.
expected_fault: Wireless security credentials do not match.

symptom: Guest Wi-Fi can access internal servers
topology_note: Guest SSID should be isolated from internal network.
show_output:
show access-lists
Guest-to-internal ACL: permit ip any any
Guest VLAN: 50
Internal VLAN: 10
expected_fault: Guest isolation policy is missing or incorrectly permits internal traffic.
